labeling.note: Items and labels were authored directly, with no model completion of any kind (AB-4 permits model labeling; this set stays zero-model by session scope). Refresh is a human ceremony with an audit stamp; anchor drift, not pool drift, is the watched failure (FOUR_JUDGE_DESIGN §5).

domain: Synthetic harbor-observation records. The domain is deliberately unrelated to this system's own subject matter so that calibration cannot teach the judge anything about the beliefs it will actually judge.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The tide gauge at Dock 9 was serviced in the week before the noon reading.
citedBytes: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
Harbor watch logged three vessels inbound before dusk.
items.rationaleSpan: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: The bytes are real and about the same gauge, and they carry nothing about servicing. Real-but-unrelated citation is the laundering shape this role exists to catch.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The channel was closed because of silt buildup.
citedBytes: The channel was closed to all traffic from the 3rd through the 11th.
items.rationaleSpan: The channel was closed to all traffic from the 3rd through the 11th.
items.why: The bytes establish the closure and say nothing about its cause. The claim's causal half has no support in the cited bytes.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: Every gauge in the harbor reported above 2 m at noon.
citedBytes: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.rationaleSpan: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: One instance is cited; a universal over all gauges is claimed. The bytes bear on the claim but carry less than it asserts.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The dock pump has never failed.
citedBytes: No pump failure was recorded during the 2044 season.
items.why: A bounded record is cited for an unbounded claim. The deciding span is the bound the claim drops.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The north light was operational through the night of the 14th.
citedBytes: North light out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th; relit by the watch.
items.rationaleSpan: North light out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th
items.why: The cited bytes state the opposite of the claim over part of the stated interval. Contradiction by the citation itself, not by outside knowledge.

items.label: clean
items.claim: Dock 9's gauge read 2.3 m at noon.
citedBytes: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.rationaleSpan: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: Direct statement by the cited bytes. The baseline clean case.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The noon reading at Dock 9 exceeded 2 m.
citedBytes: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: Entailment, not restatement. The rubric's first question asks whether the bytes state OR entail the claim; a judge that requires literal restatement fails this item.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The watch opened the log before the first vessel entry was recorded.
citedBytes: Entry 1: Log opened by the harbor watch.
items.rationaleSpan: Entry 1: Log opened by the harbor watch.
items.why: The ordering the claim asserts is carried by the cited entries' own ordinals. Unremarkable and fully supported — provenance before plausibility.

items.label: clean
items.claim: At least one harbor gauge reported above 2 m at noon.
citedBytes: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
The tide gauge at Dock 4 reads 2.1 m at noon.
items.rationaleSpan: The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: The claim asserts less than the bytes carry. Under-claiming is clean; only over-claiming is a drawback. A judge that penalizes modesty fails this item.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The harbor recorded a 4.9 m tide on the night of the storm.
citedBytes: Storm night: harbor gauge peaked at 4.9 m — the highest reading on record.
items.why: The claim may read as implausible; the cited bytes state it exactly. This role judges the citation, never the world — a judge that finds a drawback here is importing outside knowledge it was not given.
